title: Training Institute Franchise Opportunity
name: IBOSD - UK LTD, 1 Franchisee, Est'd in 2026, London HQ
description: International Board of Skills and Development - UK LTD is a registered private limited company offering international professional skills development, vocational training, and certification programs. The business is now seeking franchise partners to expand its established skills-development brand into new territories through a structured international franchise model. Franchise partners can operate District Outreach Training Centres (DORTCs) and build local networks of Authorized Training Providers and professional trainers under the brand. The central organisation provides curriculum frameworks, assessments, certification systems, trainer pathways, quality standards, and digital and administrative support. Franchise partners focus on local market development, learner acquisition, entrepreneurship, institutional relationships, infrastructure, and training delivery within their territories. The programme portfolio covers industry-relevant areas including safety, ESG, leadership, AI, industrial skills, HR, and other professional development programs. The model combines training, professional certification, membership opportunities, trainer authorisation, and institutional partnerships to create multiple avenues for franchise growth. Franchisees benefit from an international brand, defined operating standards, structured programmes, ongoing support, and the opportunity to develop sustainable district-level training businesses. The model is designed for entrepreneurs, education businesses, training organisations, and professionals seeking to build a scalable vocational and professional training operation. Holds CPD and HLACD UK credentials, is ICO registered, and has ISO certification. The franchise opportunity provides scope to expand the brand's international network while maintaining centralised quality and certification standards. The owner is currently in India and will be available for the transaction.
